items.title: 日元兩周內吐回干預漲幅一半 為何美日干預仍難解基本面壓力？
items.title_en: Why Is It Still Hard for US‑Japan Intervention to Overcome Fundamental Pressure Even After the Yen Gives Back Half of Its Gains in Two Weeks?
paras: 自美日兩國進行歷史性匯市干預帶動日元反彈至今，才短短不到兩周，日元漲幅已經回吐約一半，凸顯基本面力量愈來愈難以透過短期措施扭轉的現況。
日元目前回落到1美元兌159日元以上。在美日干預前，日元一度貶破163，干預過後最高曾升到155。
Monex集團專家董事Jesper Koll說：「干預已經嚇到市場，但並沒有阻止金融市場的規律，也就是資金會流向報酬率最高的地方……只要日本資金成本低於海外報酬率，套利交易就會重新出現。」

日元升值空間受制於美日報酬率差

根本原因在於日本與美國之間的報酬率差距。日本借貸成本仍遠低於美國及其他市場，促使投資人以低成本借入日元，再投入高收益資產，形成典型的日元套利交易(carry trade，也稱利差交易)。
目前的大環境也不利日元，美國公債殖利率走升，有利於美元，再加上油價維持在高檔，對日本這種高度仰賴能源進口的國家尤其不利。
Koll認為，干預確實成功讓投機交易不至於過度升溫，也提高放空日元交易者所承擔的風險，但並未消除支撐美元那個最基本的殖利率優勢。
State Street Global Advisors資深固定收益與外匯策略師Masahiko Loo說：「干預成功的重塑市場心理，也展現美日兩國政策協調罕見的強度。但目前還沒有消除支撐美元的殖利率優勢。」
美日殖利率差距仍然明顯：基準的10年期美國公債殖利率目前為4.686%，日本10年期公債殖利率則為2.846%，這代表投資人持有美國公債仍享有可觀的報酬誘因。
Loo說：「與其說這是成功改變基本面，不如說是成功放緩投機交易。」
目前市場把目光聚焦在日本銀行(BOJ，央行)，和預定9月召開的下一次貨幣決策會議。
Koll表示，對投資人而言，更大的衝擊並非匯市干預本身，而是日銀不願更積極收緊貨幣政策。這也讓外界質疑，決策者的行動空間是否被銀行體系問題或日本龐大的公共債務負擔限縮住了。
在日本利率沒有進一步走高、或者美國殖利率沒有下滑的情況下，投資人仍有誘因將資金投入海外市場。
Lombard Odier亞洲區投資長John Wood表示，最新一輪干預可能只帶來「有限的時間效果」，他認為日銀可能至少還需要升息兩次，才能遏制日元持續走弱的趨勢。

日元面臨多重逆風

不過，利率可能只是其中一部分原因。法國東方匯理銀行(Crédit Agricole CIB)指出，更深層的問題在於美日兩國之間的「投資力量不對稱」：美國對人工智慧(AI)及其他領域的大規模投資，持續吸引全球資金流入，但日本首相高市早苗規劃的公私部門投資計畫，目前仍尚未完全實現。
該銀行表示：「要修正日元疲弱的問題，需要的不是升息，而是擴大投資。」
這代表日元若要出現可持續的升值行情，最終仍需讓日本本身的資產變得更具吸引力，鼓勵日本國內儲蓄留在國內，而不是追逐海外報酬。
現階段來看，匯市干預的作用與其說是扭轉日元貶勢，不如說是避免日元加速貶值。

160日元成政治紅線

State Street的Loo表示，160日元已成為「政治上的紅線」，如果日元再次快速貶破這一關卡，可能促使當局再次進場干預。
Loo說：「我不排除再次干預的可能性，尤其是如果日元走勢加快或失序。但最終而言，干預只能爭取時間，真正需要發揮作用的仍是日銀貨幣政策正常化，最快可能從9月開始。」
華府與東京也試圖透過強調聯準會(Fed)提供的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回機制」(FIMA Repo Facility)，進一步強化干預的威力。該機制能讓日本以美國公債作為擔保取得美元流動性，降低日本為籌措干預資金而出售美國公債的需求。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)已表示支持擴大這項金融安全網。這可能提高押注日元貶值的成本，但並不代表背後的套利交易邏輯會因此消失。
Koll表示：「嚇阻市場很容易，但要讓市場跟著政策走，需要改變誘因，也需要信任。」
paras_en: Since the historic currency‑market intervention by the United States and Japan sparked a rebound in the yen, in less than two weeks the yen has already given back about half of its rise, highlighting how increasingly difficult it is for short‑term measures to reverse the underlying fundamentals.
The yen has now slipped back to above ¥159 per US$1. Before the intervention, the yen had fallen past ¥163, and after the intervention it briefly rose as high as ¥155.

Jesper Koll, expert director at Monex Group, said: “The intervention scared the market, but it did not stop the natural law of financial markets, which is that capital flows to the highest‑returning places… As long as Japanese funding costs are lower than overseas returns, arbitrage trades will re‑emerge.”

The yen’s upside is constrained by the US‑Japan yield gap. The root cause is the yield differential between Japan and the United States. Japan’s borrowing costs remain far below those in the US and other markets, prompting investors to borrow yen cheaply and invest in higher‑yielding assets, creating the classic yen carry trade.
The broader environment also hurts the yen: rising US Treasury yields support the dollar, and high oil prices are especially detrimental to Japan, which relies heavily on energy imports.

Koll believes the intervention succeeded in preventing speculative trades from overheating and increased the risk for those shorting the yen, but it did not eliminate the fundamental yield advantage that underpins the dollar.

Masahiko Loo, senior fixed‑income and FX strategist at State Street Global Advisors, said: “The intervention successfully reshaped market psychology and demonstrated an unusually strong coordination between US and Japanese policies. Yet it has not removed the yield advantage that supports the dollar.”

The US‑Japan yield gap remains stark: the benchmark 10‑year US Treasury yield is about 4.686%, while Japan’s 10‑year yield is roughly 2.846%, meaning investors still enjoy a sizable return incentive from holding US bonds.
Loo added: “Rather than saying this changed the fundamentals, it’s more accurate to say it slowed speculative trading.”
Market attention is now focused on the Bank of Japan and the next monetary policy meeting scheduled for September.

Koll noted that for investors the bigger shock is not the FX intervention itself but the BOJ’s reluctance to tighten policy more aggressively. This raises doubts whether policymakers’ room for action is constrained by banking‑system issues or Japan’s massive public‑debt burden.
Without higher Japanese rates or lower US yields, investors still have an incentive to allocate capital to overseas markets.

John Wood, head of Asian investments at Lombard Odier, said the latest round of intervention may only provide a “limited‑time effect” and that the BOJ likely needs at least two more rate hikes to curb the yen’s continued weakness.

The yen faces multiple headwinds. However, rates may be only part of the story. Crédit Agricole CIB pointed out a deeper issue: an “asymmetric investment power” between the US and Japan, with massive US spending on AI and other sectors drawing global capital, while Prime Minister Kishida’s public‑private investment plan remains only partially implemented.
The bank said: “Fixing the yen’s weakness requires not rate hikes but expanding investment.”
That means for the yen to achieve a sustainable appreciation, Japan’s own assets must become more attractive, encouraging domestic savings to stay at home rather than chase overseas returns.
At this stage, the role of FX intervention is less about reversing yen depreciation and more about preventing an accelerated decline.
¥160 has become a political red line. State Street’s Loo said ¥160 is now a “political red line”; a rapid breach could prompt authorities to intervene again.

Loo added: “I don’t rule out another intervention, especially if the yen’s move speeds up or becomes disorderly. Ultimately, intervention only buys time; the real driver must be BOJ policy normalization, which could start as early as September.”

Washington and Tokyo are also trying to boost the impact of intervention by emphasizing the Fed’s Foreign and International Monetary Authorities Repo (FIMA) facility, which lets Japan obtain dollar liquidity using US Treasuries as collateral, reducing the need to sell US bonds to fund intervention.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has voiced support for expanding this financial safety net. It may raise the cost of betting on yen depreciation, but it does not eliminate the underlying arbitrage logic.
Koll concluded: “Deterring the market is easy, but getting the market to follow policy requires changing incentives and building trust.”

items.title: OPEC連四次下修今年石油需求成長！沙國、俄羅斯日產量兩樣情
items.title_en: OPEC Lowers 2026 Oil Demand Growth Forecast for Fourth Consecutive Time; Saudi Arabia and Russia Show Divergent Production Levels
paras: 石油輸出國組織(OPEC)周三(12日)連續第四個月下調2026年全球石油需求成長預測，但對美伊戰爭衝擊的看法仍較國際能源總署(IEA)樂觀。與此同時，沙國7月原油產量大幅回升，俄羅斯產量卻因烏克蘭持續攻擊能源設施，較石油輸出國組織與夥伴國(OPEC+)配額低近每日100萬桶。
OPEC在最新月報中預估，2026年全球石油需求將增加每日58萬桶，為連續第四次下修。儘管如此，OPEC仍預期需求保持成長，與IEA預測今年需求將萎縮的看法形成鮮明對比，顯示兩大機構對美伊戰爭、高油價及供應受限將如何打擊消費仍存在明顯分歧。OPEC同時上調2027年石油需求成長預測。
供應方面，沙國向OPEC通報，7月原油產量由6月每日710萬桶增至820萬桶，單月回升逾每日100萬桶，反映美伊短暫停火期間波斯灣產油國逐步恢復生產，但產量仍較戰前低數百萬桶。
值得注意的是，沙國通報的產量比實際供應市場的數量高出約每日78萬桶，顯示在出口航線受阻之際，部分原油正轉入國內庫存。IEA估計，截至8月初，沙國國內原油庫存已升至至少2016年以來最高水準。
美伊停火破裂、戰火重燃後，荷姆茲海峽與紅海曼德海峽兩條沙國主要出口航道再度受到威脅，儘管中東產油國仍透過接駁等方式，低調將大量原油運出區域。向OPEC直接申報產量的七個成員國，7月合計增產每日188萬桶，主要來自沙國與伊拉克。
相較之下，俄羅斯7月原油產量平均為每日888.7萬桶，較6月小減每日6,000桶，且比OPEC+配額每日982.4萬桶低約93.7萬桶。俄羅斯產量明顯落後目標，正值烏克蘭幾乎每天攻擊其煉油廠、油輪及出口設施。
烏克蘭7月上半月集中攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，迫使煉油量降至多年低點，並推升海運原油出口至接近歷史高檔；下半月攻擊重心轉向黑海與亞速海油輪，使煉油廠獲得短暫維修時間，原油加工量回升，出口則隨之下降。本月迄今，烏克蘭已攻擊俄羅斯34座大型煉油廠中的9座，全球油市供應面臨的地緣政治壓力持續升高。
paras_en: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) on Wednesday (the 12th) lowered its forecast for global oil demand growth in 2026 for the fourth consecutive month, but its view on the impact of the U.S.-Iran war remains more optimistic than that of the International Energy Agency (IEA). At the same time, Saudi Arabia’s crude output surged in July, while Russia’s output fell about 1 million barrels per day below the OPEC+ quota due to continued Ukrainian attacks on energy facilities.

In its latest monthly report, OPEC estimates that global oil demand will increase by 580,000 barrels per day in 2026, marking the fourth successive downward revision. Nevertheless, OPEC still expects demand to grow, a stark contrast to the IEA’s projection of a demand contraction this year, highlighting a clear split between the two agencies on how the U.S.-Iran conflict, high oil prices and constrained supply will affect consumption. OPEC also raised its 2027 oil‑demand growth forecast.

On the supply side, Saudi Arabia reported to OPEC that its crude output rose from 7.10 million barrels per day in June to 8.20 million barrels per day in July, an increase of more than 1 million barrels per day for the month. The jump reflects a gradual restoration of production by Persian Gulf producers during the brief U.S.-Iran cease‑fire, although output remains several million barrels per day below pre‑war levels.

It is noteworthy that the production figure reported by Saudi Arabia exceeds the amount actually supplied to the market by about 780,000 barrels per day, indicating that some crude is being diverted to domestic storage as export routes are disrupted. The IEA estimates that, as of early August, Saudi domestic crude inventories have risen to at least the highest level seen since 2016.

After the cease‑fire between the U.S. and Iran collapsed and fighting resumed, Saudi Arabia’s two main export corridors—the Hormuz Strait and the Red Sea’s Bab el‑Mandeb—were again threatened. Nevertheless, Middle‑East producers have been quietly moving large volumes of crude out of the region via trans‑shipment and other methods. The seven OPEC members that report production directly to OPEC collectively increased output by 1.88 million barrels per day in July, driven mainly by Saudi Arabia and Iraq.

In contrast, Russia’s average crude output in July was 8.887 million barrels per day, a slight decline of 6,000 barrels per day from June and about 937,000 barrels per day below the OPEC+ quota of 9.824 million barrels per day. Russia’s production is clearly lagging its target as Ukrainian forces almost daily strike its refineries, tankers and export facilities.

During the first half of July, Ukraine focused attacks on Russian refineries, forcing refining volumes to a multi‑year low and pushing seaborne crude exports toward historic highs. In the second half of the month, the focus shifted to tankers in the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov, giving refineries a brief window for maintenance, which lifted crude processing and reduced exports. To date this month, Ukraine has hit 9 of the 34 large Russian refineries, and geopolitical pressure on global oil supplies continues to rise.

items.title: 台泥上半年EPS0.38元 整合土葡非水泥事業Cimpor International申請海外IPO
items.title_en: Taiwan Cement Reports EPS of NT$0.38 for the First Half of the Year, Plans to List Cimpor International on Overseas Stock Exchange
paras: 台泥(1101-TW)今(12)日公告上半年財報，純益32.8億元，年增241%，每股純益0.38元；另外，董事會也通過，整合旗下土、葡及非洲等水泥及混凝土建材相關業務，納入新設子公司Cimpor International Holdings，並以該公司為主體，申請於海外證券交易市場首次公開發行股票及掛牌交易。
台泥表示，Cimpor International目前以英國倫敦證券交易所或泛歐交易所作為可能的掛牌市場，台泥也預計於10月13日召開臨時股東會討論Cimpor International海外IPO案。至於全球儲能發展與建置的 NHOA Energy，以及發展歐洲充儲一體業務的 Atlante，不納入本次上市範圍，後續將另行評估。
台泥表示，推動 Cimpor International 海外上市，主要目的在於健全其資本結構、建立更多元的籌資管道，並提升國際資本市場能見度及吸引全球專業人才，透過更清楚的事業定位與獨立籌資能力，預期將有助於歐亞非洲及周邊市場水泥及混凝土建材事業的長期發展，進一步提升集團整體營收及獲利能力。
台泥指出，本次上市預計採取發行新股及轉讓既有股份並行的方式，依上市地相關規範，公眾持股比例預計不低於 Cimpor International 總股本的 10%。實際發行規模、股權比例、價格及交易條件，仍將依資金需求、市場環境、投資人認購情形，以及與主管機關、交易所和證券承銷商的協商結果確定。
台泥強調，Cimpor International 完成上市後，台泥持股比例雖可能因股權分散而有所調整，但仍將透過 TCC Dutch Holdings 維持對 Cimpor International 的控制權，並持續將其納入合併財務報表，另外，OYAK Çimento Fabrikaları A.Ş.的現有營運及其於伊斯坦堡證券交易所的上市地位亦不受影響。
台泥上半年營收達712.9億元，年增1%，毛利率18.2%，年增2.2個百分點、營業利益51.7億元，年增51%，獲利成長主要受惠土葡水泥業務銷售量價同步提升，以及旗下和平電力則因營運天數增加、能量費率上升，均帶動獲利增加。
不過，兩岸水泥業務仍面臨市場挑戰。台灣市場受到房市疲弱及進口水泥影響，加上預拌混凝土銷量減少，銷量及毛利率下降；中國大陸市場則因供需失衡及競爭加劇，水泥價格與毛利皆承壓。
截至2026年第二季底，台泥總資產為5,960億元、總負債為2,966億元，負債占總資產比率約49.8%，整體財務結構維持穩健。台泥表示，面對全球產業環境變化，公司將持續強化低碳建材、能源事業及國際市場布局，提升營運效率與財務韌性，穩健推進企業轉型。
paras_en: Taiwan Cement (1101-TW) announced its first-half financial report today, with a net profit of NT$3.28 billion, a year-on-year increase of 241%, and an EPS of NT$0.38. The board of directors also approved the integration of its cement and concrete products businesses in Taiwan, Portugal, and Africa into a new subsidiary, Cimpor International Holdings, which will be listed on an overseas stock exchange.

Taiwan Cement stated that Cimpor International is currently considering listing on the London Stock Exchange or the Euronext exchange, and the company plans to hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on October 13 to discuss the listing of Cimpor International. NHOA Energy and Atlante, which are involved in energy storage and charging infrastructure, respectively, will not be included in the initial public offering (IPO) and will be evaluated separately.

Taiwan Cement stated that the main purpose of listing Cimpor International is to strengthen its capital structure, establish a more diversified funding channel, and enhance its visibility and attractiveness to international capital markets. This is expected to help the company's long-term development in the cement and concrete products markets in Europe, Asia, Africa, and surrounding regions, and to improve the company's overall revenue and profitability.

Taiwan Cement stated that the listing will be done through the issuance of new shares and the transfer of existing shares, with a public float of at least 10% of Cimpor International's total shares. The actual issuance size, shareholding ratio, price, and trading conditions will be determined based on the company's funding needs, market environment, investor subscription, and discussions with regulatory authorities, exchanges, and underwriters.

Taiwan Cement emphasized that even after the listing, the company will maintain control over Cimpor International through TCC Dutch Holdings and will continue to consolidate its financial statements. The listing will not affect OYAK Çimento Fabrikaları A.Ş.'s existing operations or its listing on the Istanbul Stock Exchange.

Taiwan Cement's first-half revenue reached NT$71.29 billion, a year-on-year increase of 1%, with a gross margin of 18.2%, a year-on-year increase of 2.2 percentage points, and an operating profit of NT$5.17 billion, a year-on-year increase of 51%. The company's profitability growth was mainly driven by the increase in sales volume and price of cement and concrete products in Taiwan and Portugal, as well as the increase in operating days and energy prices at its Ande Power plant.

However, the company's cement business in Taiwan and China faces market challenges. The Taiwanese market is affected by the weak housing market and the impact of imported cement, while the Chinese market is affected by supply-demand imbalances and increased competition, leading to downward pressure on cement prices and margins.

As of the end of the second quarter of 2026, Taiwan Cement's total assets were NT$596 billion, with total liabilities of NT$296.6 billion, representing a debt-to-asset ratio of approximately 49.8%. The company stated that it will continue to strengthen its low-carbon materials, energy, and international business, improve operational efficiency and financial resilience, and promote a stable transformation of the company.

items.title: 微軟Win 11授權費傳已最高調漲10% OEM廠首當其衝
items.title_en: Microsoft Windows 11 License Fees Said to Have Jumped Up to 10%—OEMs Hit First
paras: 全球消費性電子產業今年深陷漲價壓力，記憶體、邏輯晶片等半導體供應短缺，不僅推升硬體成本，漲價潮如今更延燒至軟體。業界消息指出，微軟(MSFT-US) 已將 Windows 11 授權費調高最多 10%，且此次漲價並非針對 DIY 用戶，而是直接影響銷售整機的 OEM 廠商，進一步加重成本負擔。
據個人電腦OEM業者透露，微軟雖然每年皆會慣例性地微調授權費，但今年的漲幅明顯擴大，平均達到7%至10%。此外，微軟的授權費調漲並非一成不變，而是根據處理器效能採取階梯式計價，CPU越高端，費用就越高。
儘管從整體結構來看，微軟的授權費對整機價格的影響，遠不及記憶體和固態硬碟（SSD）價格的飆漲幅度，但它仍然是導致終端電腦購買成本比以往更高的一個重要因素。
面對「軟硬體齊漲」的雙重壓力，PC品牌廠今年營運挑戰不斷。消息稱，華碩和宏碁等大廠將在今年稍後將價格再上調約5%，且與2025年第四季相比，華碩產品的平均漲幅已達到30%。
有PC品牌主管坦言，雖然產品售價已陸續反映本次微軟調漲的授權費，但由於今年其他關鍵零組件漲幅實在過大，消費者與企業對於單一成本項目的變動已較難產生明顯感受。
雪上加霜的是，近階段個人電腦出貨量也出現了明顯下滑。根據Counterpoint Research報告顯示，2026年第二季全球個人電腦市場出貨量年減約4%至4.9%，這是自2025年第一季度以來全球PC市場首次出現下滑。
聯想集團(00992-HK) 、惠普(HPQ-US) 、戴爾(DELL-US) 等主要生產商均面臨銷售量下滑的困境，蘋果則成為少數出貨量逆勢增加10%以上的廠商。
雖然持續攀升的價格理論上能提升企業的利潤，但Counterpoint指出，Windows系統遷移周期和AI PC普及雖然仍在支撐部分商業換機需求，持續攀升的記憶體價格和零組件成本卻正在兩頭擠壓OEM廠商。
業界擔憂，如果這種價格上漲趨勢持續失控，消費者未來可能不再傾向於購買新電腦，這對整體產業來說無疑是個巨大的隱憂。
paras_en: The global consumer electronics industry is under intense price‑increase pressure this year, with shortages of memory, logic chips and other semiconductors driving up hardware costs, and the inflation wave now spreading to software. Industry sources say Microsoft (MSFT‑US) has raised Windows 11 licensing fees by as much as 10%, and the hike is not aimed at DIY users but directly impacts OEMs that sell complete systems, further burdening their cost base.

According to a PC OEM, Microsoft typically makes small annual adjustments to its licensing fees, but this year’s increase is markedly larger, averaging between 7% and 10%. Moreover, the fee hike is tiered by processor performance—the higher‑end the CPU, the higher the charge.

Although, in the overall cost structure, Microsoft’s licensing fees affect the final price of a system far less than the soaring prices of memory and solid‑state drives (SSDs), they remain a significant factor that makes end‑user computer purchase costs higher than before.

Facing a “software‑and‑hardware‑both‑rising” double pressure, PC brands are confronting continual operational challenges this year. Sources say major makers such as Asus and Acer will raise their prices by roughly another 5% later this year, and compared with Q4 2025, the average price increase for Asus products has already reached 30%.

A PC brand executive admitted that although product prices have begun to reflect Microsoft’s licensing fee increase, the magnitude of price hikes in other key components this year is so large that consumers and enterprises find it hard to notice the impact of any single cost item.

Adding to the strain, recent PC shipment volumes have shown a clear decline. Counterpoint Research reports that global PC shipments in Q2 2026 fell year‑over‑year by about 4% to 4.9%, marking the first decline in the global PC market since Q1 2025.

Major manufacturers such as Lenovo Group (00992‑HK), HP (HPQ‑US) and Dell (DELL‑US) are all facing falling sales, while Apple is one of the few companies whose shipments have risen by more than 10% against the trend.

Although rising prices theoretically can boost corporate margins, Counterpoint notes that the Windows migration cycle and the spread of AI PCs still support some business‑upgrade demand, but the continuously climbing memory prices and component costs are squeezing OEMs from both ends.

The industry worries that if this price‑increase trend continues unchecked, consumers may become reluctant to buy new computers in the future, which would pose a huge hidden risk to the entire sector.

items.title: 強行升息只會把事情搞砸！摩根大通策略師警告Fed別操之過急
items.title_en: JPMorgan Strategist Warns Fed Against Overstepping on Rate Hikes
paras: 摩根大通資產管理(JPMorgan Asset Management)全球首席策略師David Kelly表示，聯準會(Fed)應維持利率不變，而且最終也很可能選擇按兵不動，因為美國通膨正沿著明確的降溫軌道前進，持續性薪資—物價螺旋成形的風險也逐漸下降。
美國7月核心通膨表現溫和，數據公布後美債延續漲勢。Kelly接受《彭博》電視訪問時直言，Fed「絕對應該」維持利率不變，試圖透過升息加快通膨回落，不僅無法帶來好處，反而可能破壞經濟與金融市場。
Kelly認為，三股力量正共同推動通膨降溫。首先，關稅成本的年增影響將逐步減弱；其次，市場對美伊戰爭結束抱持樂觀期待，有望帶動油價回落；最後，薪資成長持續落後於通膨，使物價壓力缺乏自我強化所需的燃料，Fed也就沒有非升息不可的理由。
他將當前情況形容為美國正面臨「鐵氟龍式通膨」(Teflon inflation)，意指通膨壓力不會牢牢黏住經濟。Kelly表示，通膨就像傷勢一樣，只能緩慢痊癒，若強行加快過程，反而可能把事情弄得更糟；只要薪資沒有跟著物價加速上漲，就難以形成薪資—物價螺旋。
Kelly也批評Fed近期的溝通策略，認為主席華許(Kevin Warsh)8月底在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)全球央行年會的演說將是關鍵時刻。華許必須稍微收回先前過於強硬的論調，承認Fed在抑制通膨方面已取得一定進展。他並認為，Fed暗示未來將減少與市場溝通，是走在錯誤的道路上。
至於升息是否能重建Fed抗通膨公信力，進而壓低長天期美債殖利率，Kelly坦言這是一個難以判斷的選擇。但他警告，相較升息，量化緊縮可能是更危險的政策工具，因為對長期利率的推升作用更強；若同時升息與縮減資產負債表，恐增加市場失序的風險。
Kelly指出，目前金融市場槓桿程度相當高，即使只是小幅升息，也可能觸發各類資產重新定價。短期利率升高將促使投資人轉向較安全的資產，抽走部分市場上漲動能，Fed沒有必要為了加速通膨降溫而承擔這項風險。
paras_en: JPMorgan Asset Management's global chief strategist David Kelly says the Federal Reserve should keep interest rates unchanged and is likely to do so as US inflation is moving along a clear downward trajectory, with the risk of a persistent wage-price spiral diminishing.

US core inflation showed a mild performance in July, and after the data was released, US Treasury yields continued to rise. Kelly told Bloomberg TV that the Fed "absolutely should" keep interest rates unchanged, attempting to accelerate inflation decline through rate hikes, which would not only fail to bring benefits but could also damage the economy and financial markets.

Kelly believes that three forces are driving down inflation. Firstly, the year-over-year impact of tariff costs will gradually weaken; secondly, the market's optimistic expectations for the end of the US-Iran war may lead to a decline in oil prices; and thirdly, wage growth continues to lag behind inflation, making it difficult for prices to sustain themselves, leaving the Fed without a reason to raise interest rates.

He describes the current situation as the US facing "Teflon inflation," meaning that inflationary pressure will not stick to the economy. Kelly says that inflation is like an injury, which can only heal slowly, and that forcing a faster process could make things worse; as long as wages do not accelerate with prices, it is difficult to form a wage-price spiral.

Kelly also criticizes the Fed's recent communication strategy, saying that Chairman Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Conference at the end of August will be a critical moment. Warsh must slightly retract his previous overly hawkish tone and acknowledge that the Fed has made some progress in suppressing inflation. He also believes that the Fed's hint that it will reduce market communication is on the wrong track.

As for whether rate hikes can rebuild the Fed's credibility in fighting inflation and thereby lower long-term US Treasury yields, Kelly says it is a difficult choice to make. However, he warns that quantitative tightening may be a more dangerous policy tool, as it has a stronger impact on long-term interest rates; if the Fed raises interest rates and reduces its balance sheet at the same time, it may increase the risk of market disorder.

Kelly notes that the financial market's leverage is currently high, and even a small rate hike could trigger a re-pricing of various assets. Higher short-term interest rates would encourage investors to move to safer assets, draining some of the market's upward momentum, and the Fed does not need to take on this risk to accelerate the decline of inflation.

items.title: Fed下月可以先不升息？華爾街解讀7月CPI三大訊號
paras: 美國7月消費者物價指數(CPI)符合預期，未出現市場擔心的意外升溫，稍微緩解聯準會(Fed)9月升息壓力。華爾街分析師從中讀出三大訊號：核心通膨持續降溫、勞動市場轉弱支持Fed繼續觀望，但部分基礎物價壓力仍高，加上中東局勢與油價前景充滿變數。因此，這份報告雖有助於強化9月按兵不動的理由，卻仍不足以宣告通膨警報解除。
美國7月CPI月增0.1%、年增3.4%，核心CPI月增0.2%、年增2.5%，均符合市場預期。美股開高，美國2年期與10年期公債殖利率分別下跌4.2個及3.2個基點，美元指數小跌0.1%。利率期貨顯示，市場預估Fed在9月15日至16日維持利率於3.50%至3.75%的機率約55%，與數據公布前相差不大。

數據不差但也不夠好 9月升息之爭尚未落幕

高盛資產管理(Goldman Sachs Asset Management)多元固定收益投資主管Lindsay Rosner形容，7月CPI只是Fed 9月會議前的「第一關」，由於屆時還有另一輪通膨數據出爐，目前各種可能性仍然存在。不過，核心通膨維持受控，延續前一個月基礎物價壓力趨緩的正面跡象，確實進一步強化9月按兵不動的理由。
Natixis美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge表示，通膨正緩慢但穩定地沿著降溫路徑前進，這已是核心CPI連續第三個月傳出令人鼓舞的結果，近三個月年化增幅更連續四個月下降，顯示廣泛性通膨壓力持續減弱。在上周五就業報告表現慘淡後，市場對「正面通膨數據」的認定門檻已經放寬，而7月CPI顯然符合條件。
Dakota Wealth資深投資組合經理Robert Pavlik指出，市場之所以做出小幅正面反應，不是因為數據特別亮眼，而是投資人原先擔心通膨可能比預期更糟。如今結果完全符合預估，加上疲弱的非農就業報告，降低Fed因能源價格推升通膨而被迫升息的疑慮。
CFRA Research首席投資策略師Sam Stovall認為，通膨沒有意外上升，加上近期經濟成長及就業表現轉弱，Fed 9月升息的可能性很低，今年甚至很可能完全不升息。雖然新任Fed主席首次政策行動過去往往偏向升息，Fed也面臨維護抗通膨公信力的壓力，但目前經濟恐難承受積極緊縮；即使利率小幅上調，也不太可能是新一輪激進升息循環的起點。

鷹派仍不死心 價格穩定公信力成升息理由

並非所有分析師都認為Fed已無須升息。施羅德(Schroders)資深經濟學家George Brown指出，7月CPI並未真正解決Fed下一步行動的爭論。勞動市場看似轉弱，但部分基礎通膨指標仍亮起紅燈，決策官員在9月會議前面對的是相互矛盾的訊號。
Brown表示，近期長天期美債遭到拋售，使Fed更須避免市場懷疑其維護價格穩定的決心。鷹派言論能發揮的作用有限，實際行動往往比口頭承諾更具說服力，因此他仍認為利率最終方向偏高，只是首次升息的時間尚不明確。
Allspring Global Investments固定收益首席投資策略師George Bory則認為，美國通膨可能已越過高峰，7月數據確實減輕Fed的部分壓力，但現在宣告一切安全仍言之過早，因為若干基礎通膨指標依舊偏高。他預期Fed今年不會升息，但這項判斷很大程度取決於油價與中東情勢。
Capital.com資深市場分析師Daniela Hathorn也表示，這是一份對Fed有幫助的報告，卻不是解除警報的訊號。通膨在先前能源衝擊後朝正確方向前進，近期就業市場疲弱，也讓官員更缺乏9月再次升息的理由；然而，整體CPI年增率仍達3.4%，明顯高於Fed的2%目標，能源價格也較去年同期高出近15%，Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)不太可能就此宣告勝利。

油價仍是最大變數 消費者疲態反而壓低漲價空間

Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen形容，通膨尚未亮起「紅色警報」，雖然整體表現仍稱不上理想，但方向正在改善。部分領域依然存在極端價格壓力，例如電腦軟體與配件價格年增21.2%；相較之下，住宅與保險通膨正逐步回落，目前也沒有明確證據顯示，劇烈波動的能源價格已擴散至其他消費項目。
Jacobsen指出，長期承受高物價的消費者已顯疲憊，購買力與承受漲價的能力下降，反而限制生產商把成本轉嫁給消費者的空間。這可能有助於抑制通膨的廣泛擴散，但也反映家庭生活成本壓力仍未解除。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，在疲弱就業數據與市場預期CPI偏軟的背景下，他原本預期美元會有更明顯跌勢，但匯市反應相當有限。CPI公布後美元僅略為走弱，顯示市場只是非常小幅地下調9月升息機率。
分析師的共同結論是，7月CPI沒有把Fed推向升息，卻也沒有徹底排除升息。通膨降溫與就業疲弱提高9月按兵不動的合理性，但油價走勢、8月就業與通膨數據，以及Fed維護政策公信力的考量，仍可能改變最終結果。

items.title: 台灣大斥資上限291億元、溢價29.5%收購精誠股權 目標持股過半
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile to Spend Up to NT$29.13 Billion, Paying a 29.5% Premium, to Acquire a Controlling Stake in Systex
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(12)日召開重訊記者會，宣布將透過全資子公司「台信電訊」公開收購精誠資訊(6214-TW)普通股，目標增持至少39%，總持股將過半，全案收購價金上限達291.3億元。總經理林之晨指出，對於此次收購所產生的綜效具高度信心，取得過半股權後，最快今年可大幅提升雙方營收與獲利。
林之晨認為，此次公開收購精誠股權，希望在AI時代裡，透過雙方深度的ICT結盟，整合資訊IT與電信CT，創造「跨售」、「AI」與「區域化」三大綜效，目標在資服產業的市占率能夠從7%，倍增至14%，進一步推升台灣大在4、5年後營收可達千億規模。
林之晨指出，此次公開收購的對價為一半現金、一半換股，應賣1股精誠普通股，可換取台灣大普通股0.84股及現金92.5元。
若以台灣大及精誠今天收盤價計算，相當於每股收購價約當184.5元，溢價約29.5%；以近一季平均收盤價計算，溢價則約32.5%；以近半年收盤價計算，溢價約38.5%。
台灣大說明，此次目標取得至少39%、最高58%精誠資訊股權，全案收購價金為195.8億元至291.3億元。另外，此次收購所需對價總數為台信電訊持有台灣大普通股89186829股到132636822股(約占台灣大2.4至3.6%股權)，現金對價總額為98.21至146.06億元，將以自有資金及台灣大集團內部關係人借款支應。
林之晨提到，此次公開收購預計8月18日開始，目標50天內完成，須向公平會申請並獲得通過，且收購股份需達39%，待2項條件達成後才可交割。待台灣大取得精誠過半股權，未來除可用權益法認列獲利，若經董事會改選，也能夠合併報表，希望最快今年就可以發生。
因此林之晨表示，短期首要任務就是在股權過半後，進行董事會改選，但他強調，改選後還是希望維持現在經營團隊的穩定。同時，雙方團隊將進行深度策略聯盟，包括業務與商品資訊的交換，讓綜效極大化。
針對日本與東南亞市場，林之晨指出，精誠在新加坡成立SYSTEX Asia東南亞營運總部，在日本也與伊藤忠商事合作，待收購完成，將進一步與精誠共同在東南亞與日本市場推進AI相關業務布局。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) held a major press conference today (the 12th) announcing that it will publicly acquire ordinary shares of Systex Information (6214‑TW) through its wholly‑owned subsidiary Taiwan Telecom. The goal is to increase its holding by at least 39% to a majority stake, with the total purchase price capped at NT$29.13 billion. General Manager Lin Chih‑chen said the company is highly confident about the synergies from the deal and, once it holds more than half the shares, it could significantly boost both parties’ revenue and profit as early as this year.

Lin said the public acquisition of Systex aims to forge a deep ICT alliance in the AI era, integrating information‑technology (IT) and telecommunications (CT) to create three major synergies – cross‑selling, AI, and regionalization. The target is to double Systex’s market share in the IT services sector from 7% to 14%, which would help Taiwan Mobile’s revenue reach the NT$1 trillion level in four to five years.

Lin explained that the consideration for the public purchase will be half cash and half share‑swap: for each Systex ordinary share sold, the seller will receive 0.84 Taiwan Mobile ordinary shares plus NT$92.5 in cash.

Based on today’s closing prices of Taiwan Mobile and Systex, the implied per‑share purchase price is about NT$184.5, a premium of roughly 29.5%. Using the average closing price over the past quarter the premium is about 32.5%, and using the average over the past six months the premium is about 38.5%.

Taiwan Mobile clarified that it aims to acquire at least 39% and up to 58% of Systex, with the total purchase price ranging from NT$19.58 billion to NT$29.13 billion. The consideration includes Taiwan Telecom holding between 89,186,829 and 132,636,822 Taiwan Mobile ordinary shares (about 2.4%–3.6% of Taiwan Mobile’s equity) and a cash component of NT$9.821 billion to NT$14.606 billion, to be funded with internal cash and loans from related parties within the Taiwan Mobile group.

Lin said the public acquisition is slated to start on August 18 and is expected to be completed within 50 days, subject to filing with and approval by the Fair Trade Commission. The transaction will only close once the 39% share threshold is met and two other conditions are satisfied. After Taiwan Mobile obtains a majority stake in Systex, it can recognize profits under the equity method and, if the board is re‑elected, consolidate Systex’s financial statements, potentially as early as this year.

Therefore, Lin stated that the short‑term priority after crossing the 50% ownership line is to hold a board election, while emphasizing that the existing management team will remain stable after the election. Both companies will also deepen their strategic alliance, including the exchange of business and product information, to maximize synergies.

Regarding Japan and Southeast Asia, Lin noted that Systex has established a Southeast Asia operations headquarters, SYSTEX Asia, in Singapore and has a partnership with Itochu Corp. in Japan. Once the acquisition is completed, the two firms will jointly advance AI‑related business initiatives in Southeast Asian and Japanese markets.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉7月CPI報喜緩解升息疑慮 主要指數開高、美債殖利率下滑
items.title_en: US Stocks Rise as July CPI Data Eases Rate Hike Concerns
paras: 美國7月通膨數據符合預期，緩解市場對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的擔憂，美股主要指數周三(12日)開高。標普500指數上漲0.5%，徘徊在歷史高點附近；那斯達克綜合指數上漲0.9%，道瓊工業指數上漲151點或0.3%。
AI概念股CoreWeave與美超微領漲科技股，那斯達克100指數一度上漲約1%。債市同步走強，美國2年期公債殖利率下跌4個基點至4.17%，貨幣市場則下調Fed在9月升息的押注。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲逾 160 點或近 0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近 60 點或 近 0.2%，標普 500 指數漲 0.02%，費城半導體指數漲 1.0%。台積電 ADR 漲近 0.4%。
美國7月消費者物價指數(CPI)符合市場預期，緩解投資人對Fed近期升息的擔憂，帶動美股期指與美債價格周三同步上漲。科技股反彈進一步提振市場情緒，那斯達克100指數期貨漲幅達1%，標普500指數可望延續8月以來的漲勢。
債市方面，對Fed政策較敏感的美國2年期公債殖利率下跌3個基點至4.18%，貨幣市場也降低對Fed在9月升息的押注。在地緣政治風險與油價仍處高檔之際，通膨數據未進一步惡化，令華爾街交易員鬆一口氣。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)公布，7月整體CPI月增0.1%、年增3.4%；剔除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI月增0.2%、年增2.5%，均符合市場預期。其中，核心CPI年增幅追平2021年3月以來最低水準，顯示基礎通膨壓力持續趨緩。
在上周五公布的7月就業報告表現疲弱後，物價漲勢降溫可能進一步減輕Fed對通膨的焦慮。Fed於7月29日決議維持利率不變，但有三名官員投下反對票並主張升息，凸顯決策內部分歧。
高盛資產管理(Goldman Sachs Asset Management)的Lindsay Rosner表示，核心通膨維持受控，延續6月數據顯示的基礎通膨降溫跡象，進一步強化Fed在9月按兵不動的理由。
由於Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)試圖減少央行對政策意圖的事前暗示，打破近年在正式決策前引導市場預期的慣例，經濟數據對市場的重要性也隨之提高。Fed上月維持利率不變後，長天期美債殖利率一度升至近20年高點。
Regan Capital的Skyler Weinand指出，7月CPI符合預期固然是好消息，但通膨數據正愈來愈緊密地跟隨油價變化，而Fed無法控制荷姆茲海峽局勢，這意味著通膨回落至2%目標的道路依然漫長且充滿不確定性。
Weinand表示，通膨雖處於高檔但大致穩定，Fed仍將依據數據決定下一步行動。距離9月會議前還有數項重要經濟數據待公布，升息與否尚未完全定案。
其他市場方面，油價震盪，交易員持續評估各方能否達成協議，恢復荷姆茲海峽的能源運輸。

paras_en: US stocks rose on Wednesday as July inflation data met expectations, easing concerns about a potential interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve in September. The S&P 500 index rose 0.5%, hovering near its historic high, while the Nasdaq Composite index rose 0.9% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 151 points or 0.3%.

AI concept stocks, including CoreWeave and Supermicro, led the gains in technology stocks, with the Nasdaq 100 index rising about 1% at one point. The bond market also strengthened, with the yield on the 2-year US Treasury note falling 4 basis points to 4.17%, and the money market reducing its bets on a rate hike by the Fed in September.

As of the close of trading, the Dow Jones Industrial Average had risen by over 160 points or nearly 0.3%, the Nasdaq Composite index had fallen by nearly 60 points or nearly 0.2%, the S&P 500 index had risen by 0.02%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index had risen by 1.0%. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) ADRs rose by nearly 0.4%.

The US consumer price index (CPI) for July met market expectations, easing concerns about a potential rate hike by the Fed, and boosting US stock futures and bond prices on Wednesday. The rebound in technology stocks further lifted market sentiment, with the Nasdaq 100 index futures rising by 1%, and the S&P 500 index expected to continue its upward trend since August.

In the bond market, the yield on the 2-year US Treasury note, which is more sensitive to Fed policy, fell by 3 basis points to 4.18%, and the money market reduced its bets on a rate hike by the Fed in September. With geopolitical risks and oil prices still high, the fact that inflation data did not worsen further eased concerns on Wall Street.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported that the overall CPI rose 0.1% in July from the previous month and 3.4% from a year ago, while the core CPI, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 0.2% in July from the previous month and 2.5% from a year ago, both meeting market expectations.

The core CPI's annual growth rate matched its lowest level since March 2021, indicating that underlying inflationary pressures continued to ease. After a weak jobs report was released last Friday, the easing of price pressures may further alleviate the Fed's concerns about inflation.

The Fed decided to keep interest rates unchanged on July 29, but three officials voted against the decision and advocated for a rate hike, highlighting the division within the Fed's decision-making process.

Lindsay Rosner of Goldman Sachs Asset Management said that the core inflation rate remained under control, continuing the trend of easing underlying inflation seen in June's data, and further strengthened the case for the Fed to keep interest rates unchanged in September.

Since Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh has tried to reduce the central bank's forward guidance on policy intentions, breaking the tradition of guiding market expectations before formal decisions, the importance of economic data to the market has increased. After the Fed kept interest rates unchanged last month, long-term US Treasury yields rose to near 20-year highs.

Skyler Weinand of Regan Capital pointed out that while the July CPI meeting expectations was good news, inflation data is becoming increasingly closely tied to oil price changes, and the Fed cannot control the situation in the Hormuz Strait, which means that the road to reducing inflation to the 2% target is still long and uncertain.

Weinand said that although inflation is high but stable, the Fed will still make decisions based on data. With several important economic data releases before the September meeting, the possibility of a rate hike is not entirely ruled out.
In other markets, oil prices fluctuated as traders continued to assess the possibility of an agreement to restore energy transportation through the Hormuz Strait.

As of 9 pm Taipei time on Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average had risen by 63.60 points or 0.12% to 53,855.45, the Nasdaq Composite index had risen by 156.57 points or 0.59% to 26,602.02, and the S&P 500 index had risen by 24.56 points or 0.32% to 7,752.76.

Supermicro (SMCI-US) stock price rose by 16.84% to $36.92 in early trading. The company not only reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings but also released an optimistic forecast for the first quarter.

CoreWeave (CRWV-US) stock price rose by 22.41% to $110.56 in early trading. The company's adjusted operating profit margin for the second quarter reached 5%, exceeding the 2.7% expected by FactSet analysts, and its revenue rose by 112% year-over-year to $2.58 billion, also beating expectations.

Nebius Group (NBIS-US) stock price rose by 16.22% to $224.57. The company's revenue and earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) both exceeded FactSet analysts' expectations, and its gross margin was higher than market estimates, driving the stock price up.

Today's key economic data includes: US July CPI annual growth rate of 3.4%, in line with expectations, US July CPI monthly growth rate of 0.1%, in line with expectations, US July core CPI annual growth rate of 2.5%, in line with expectations, and US July core CPI monthly growth rate of 0.2%, in line with expectations.

Wall Street analysis: Omdia said in a report that due to continued strong demand for AI, the DRAM and NAND markets will see strong growth, and the global semiconductor market revenue is expected to grow by 94.1% in 2026, with storage chip revenue accounting for more than 50% of the total semiconductor revenue.

Meanwhile, AI demand has exceeded the current semiconductor industry's chip manufacturing and packaging capacity, and bottlenecks in key areas such as high-bandwidth memory (HBM), advanced packaging, and advanced process capacity are expected to last at least until 2027.

items.title: 台泥上半年EPS0.38元 整合土葡非水泥事業Cimpor International申請海外IPO
items.title_en: Taiwan Cement Reports EPS of NT$0.38 for the First Half of the Year, Plans to List Cimpor International on Overseas Stock Exchange
paras: 台泥(1101-TW)今(12)日公告上半年財報，純益32.8億元，年增241%，每股純益0.38元；另外，董事會也通過，整合旗下土、葡及非洲等水泥及混凝土建材相關業務，納入新設子公司Cimpor International Holdings，並以該公司為主體，申請於海外證券交易市場首次公開發行股票及掛牌交易。
台泥表示，Cimpor International目前以英國倫敦證券交易所或泛歐交易所作為可能的掛牌市場，台泥也預計於10月13日召開臨時股東會討論Cimpor International海外IPO案。至於全球儲能發展與建置的 NHOA Energy，以及發展歐洲充儲一體業務的 Atlante，不納入本次上市範圍，後續將另行評估。
台泥表示，推動 Cimpor International 海外上市，主要目的在於健全其資本結構、建立更多元的籌資管道，並提升國際資本市場能見度及吸引全球專業人才，透過更清楚的事業定位與獨立籌資能力，預期將有助於歐亞非洲及周邊市場水泥及混凝土建材事業的長期發展，進一步提升集團整體營收及獲利能力。
台泥指出，本次上市預計採取發行新股及轉讓既有股份並行的方式，依上市地相關規範，公眾持股比例預計不低於 Cimpor International 總股本的 10%。實際發行規模、股權比例、價格及交易條件，仍將依資金需求、市場環境、投資人認購情形，以及與主管機關、交易所和證券承銷商的協商結果確定。
台泥強調，Cimpor International 完成上市後，台泥持股比例雖可能因股權分散而有所調整，但仍將透過 TCC Dutch Holdings 維持對 Cimpor International 的控制權，並持續將其納入合併財務報表，另外，OYAK Çimento Fabrikaları A.Ş.的現有營運及其於伊斯坦堡證券交易所的上市地位亦不受影響。
台泥上半年營收達712.9億元，年增1%，毛利率18.2%，年增2.2個百分點、營業利益51.7億元，年增51%，獲利成長主要受惠土葡水泥業務銷售量價同步提升，以及旗下和平電力則因營運天數增加、能量費率上升，均帶動獲利增加。
不過，兩岸水泥業務仍面臨市場挑戰。台灣市場受到房市疲弱及進口水泥影響，加上預拌混凝土銷量減少，銷量及毛利率下降；中國大陸市場則因供需失衡及競爭加劇，水泥價格與毛利皆承壓。
截至2026年第二季底，台泥總資產為5,960億元、總負債為2,966億元，負債占總資產比率約49.8%，整體財務結構維持穩健。台泥表示，面對全球產業環境變化，公司將持續強化低碳建材、能源事業及國際市場布局，提升營運效率與財務韌性，穩健推進企業轉型。
paras_en: Taiwan Cement (1101-TW) announced its first-half financial report today, with a net profit of NT$3.28 billion, a year-on-year increase of 241%, and an EPS of NT$0.38. The board of directors also approved the integration of its cement and concrete products businesses in Taiwan, Portugal, and Africa into a new subsidiary, Cimpor International Holdings, which will be listed on an overseas stock exchange.

Taiwan Cement stated that Cimpor International is currently considering listing on the London Stock Exchange or the Euronext exchange, and the company plans to hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on October 13 to discuss the listing of Cimpor International. NHOA Energy and Atlante, which are involved in energy storage and charging infrastructure, respectively, will not be included in the initial public offering (IPO) and will be evaluated separately.

Taiwan Cement stated that the main purpose of listing Cimpor International is to strengthen its capital structure, establish a more diversified funding channel, and enhance its visibility and attractiveness to international capital markets. This is expected to help the company's long-term development in the cement and concrete products markets in Europe, Asia, Africa, and surrounding regions, and to improve the company's overall revenue and profitability.

Taiwan Cement stated that the listing will be done through the issuance of new shares and the transfer of existing shares, with a public float of at least 10% of Cimpor International's total shares. The actual issuance size, shareholding ratio, price, and trading conditions will be determined based on the company's funding needs, market environment, investor subscription, and discussions with regulatory authorities, exchanges, and underwriters.

Taiwan Cement emphasized that even after the listing, the company will maintain control over Cimpor International through TCC Dutch Holdings and will continue to consolidate its financial statements. The listing will not affect OYAK Çimento Fabrikaları A.Ş.'s existing operations or its listing on the Istanbul Stock Exchange.

Taiwan Cement's first-half revenue reached NT$71.29 billion, a year-on-year increase of 1%, with a gross margin of 18.2%, a year-on-year increase of 2.2 percentage points, and an operating profit of NT$5.17 billion, a year-on-year increase of 51%. The company's profitability growth was mainly driven by the increase in sales volume and price of cement and concrete products in Taiwan and Portugal, as well as the increase in operating days and energy prices at its Ande Power plant.

However, the company's cement business in Taiwan and China faces market challenges. The Taiwanese market is affected by the weak housing market and the impact of imported cement, while the Chinese market is affected by supply-demand imbalances and increased competition, leading to downward pressure on cement prices and margins.

As of the end of the second quarter of 2026, Taiwan Cement's total assets were NT$596 billion, with total liabilities of NT$296.6 billion, representing a debt-to-asset ratio of approximately 49.8%. The company stated that it will continue to strengthen its low-carbon materials, energy, and international business, improve operational efficiency and financial resilience, and promote a stable transformation of the company.

items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile to Spend Up to NT$29.13 Billion, Paying a 29.5% Premium, to Acquire a Controlling Stake in Systex
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(12)日召開重訊記者會，宣布將透過全資子公司「台信電訊」公開收購精誠資訊(6214-TW)普通股，目標增持至少39%，總持股將過半，全案收購價金上限達291.3億元。總經理林之晨指出，對於此次收購所產生的綜效具高度信心，取得過半股權後，最快今年可大幅提升雙方營收與獲利。
林之晨認為，此次公開收購精誠股權，希望在AI時代裡，透過雙方深度的ICT結盟，整合資訊IT與電信CT，創造「跨售」、「AI」與「區域化」三大綜效，目標在資服產業的市占率能夠從7%，倍增至14%，進一步推升台灣大在4、5年後營收可達千億規模。
林之晨指出，此次公開收購的對價為一半現金、一半換股，應賣1股精誠普通股，可換取台灣大普通股0.84股及現金92.5元。
若以台灣大及精誠今天收盤價計算，相當於每股收購價約當184.5元，溢價約29.5%；以近一季平均收盤價計算，溢價則約32.5%；以近半年收盤價計算，溢價約38.5%。
台灣大說明，此次目標取得至少39%、最高58%精誠資訊股權，全案收購價金為195.8億元至291.3億元。另外，此次收購所需對價總數為台信電訊持有台灣大普通股89186829股到132636822股(約占台灣大2.4至3.6%股權)，現金對價總額為98.21至146.06億元，將以自有資金及台灣大集團內部關係人借款支應。
林之晨提到，此次公開收購預計8月18日開始，目標50天內完成，須向公平會申請並獲得通過，且收購股份需達39%，待2項條件達成後才可交割。待台灣大取得精誠過半股權，未來除可用權益法認列獲利，若經董事會改選，也能夠合併報表，希望最快今年就可以發生。
因此林之晨表示，短期首要任務就是在股權過半後，進行董事會改選，但他強調，改選後還是希望維持現在經營團隊的穩定。同時，雙方團隊將進行深度策略聯盟，包括業務與商品資訊的交換，讓綜效極大化。
針對日本與東南亞市場，林之晨指出，精誠在新加坡成立SYSTEX Asia東南亞營運總部，在日本也與伊藤忠商事合作，待收購完成，將進一步與精誠共同在東南亞與日本市場推進AI相關業務布局。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) held a major press conference today (the 12th) announcing that it will publicly acquire ordinary shares of Systex Information (6214‑TW) through its wholly‑owned subsidiary Taiwan Telecom. The goal is to increase its holding by at least 39% to a majority stake, with the total purchase price capped at NT$29.13 billion. General Manager Lin Chih‑chen said the company is highly confident about the synergies from the deal and, once it holds more than half the shares, it could significantly boost both parties’ revenue and profit as early as this year.

Lin said the public acquisition of Systex aims to forge a deep ICT alliance in the AI era, integrating information‑technology (IT) and telecommunications (CT) to create three major synergies – cross‑selling, AI, and regionalization. The target is to double Systex’s market share in the IT services sector from 7% to 14%, which would help Taiwan Mobile’s revenue reach the NT$1 trillion level in four to five years.

Lin explained that the consideration for the public purchase will be half cash and half share‑swap: for each Systex ordinary share sold, the seller will receive 0.84 Taiwan Mobile ordinary shares plus NT$92.5 in cash.

Based on today’s closing prices of Taiwan Mobile and Systex, the implied per‑share purchase price is about NT$184.5, a premium of roughly 29.5%. Using the average closing price over the past quarter the premium is about 32.5%, and using the average over the past six months the premium is about 38.5%.

Taiwan Mobile clarified that it aims to acquire at least 39% and up to 58% of Systex, with the total purchase price ranging from NT$19.58 billion to NT$29.13 billion. The consideration includes Taiwan Telecom holding between 89,186,829 and 132,636,822 Taiwan Mobile ordinary shares (about 2.4%–3.6% of Taiwan Mobile’s equity) and a cash component of NT$9.821 billion to NT$14.606 billion, to be funded with internal cash and loans from related parties within the Taiwan Mobile group.

Lin said the public acquisition is slated to start on August 18 and is expected to be completed within 50 days, subject to filing with and approval by the Fair Trade Commission. The transaction will only close once the 39% share threshold is met and two other conditions are satisfied. After Taiwan Mobile obtains a majority stake in Systex, it can recognize profits under the equity method and, if the board is re‑elected, consolidate Systex’s financial statements, potentially as early as this year.

Therefore, Lin stated that the short‑term priority after crossing the 50% ownership line is to hold a board election, while emphasizing that the existing management team will remain stable after the election. Both companies will also deepen their strategic alliance, including the exchange of business and product information, to maximize synergies.

Regarding Japan and Southeast Asia, Lin noted that Systex has established a Southeast Asia operations headquarters, SYSTEX Asia, in Singapore and has a partnership with Itochu Corp. in Japan. Once the acquisition is completed, the two firms will jointly advance AI‑related business initiatives in Southeast Asian and Japanese markets.

items.title: 【奇鋐法說會AI摘要】 2026/8/12
paras:
一、奇鋐(3017-TW)2026年第二季財務與營運詳情 



獲利能力顯著提升：第二季毛利率32.57%，較第一季提升2.8個百分點，較去年同期增加8.16個百分點；營業利益率27.44%；單季EPS 24.37元，年增136.6%。營收成長正有效轉化為更高的獲利品質，重心已從規模擴張轉向獲利品質。
營收與產品組合持續優化：上半年營收981億元，年增85.5%。Thermol與Chassis產品合計佔比83.42%，成長主動能來自伺服器應用：上半年伺服器營收年增153.4%，佔比由48.4%升至66.1%，是優化產品組合與提升毛利率的關鍵。
財務狀況穩健，現金流強勁：截至6月底，現金777億元，股東權益551.97億元；負債比降至68.07%。雖受供應鏈影響存貨週轉天數增至145天，但流動性充足。上半年營業活動現金流入262億元，年增175%；自由現金流191.979億元，近三倍成長，顯示營運現金流強勁。

【奇鋐法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)】 

Q1：今年下半年的營收與毛利展望為何？ 

回答：公司維持先前的展望，下半年產品陸續進入量產階段，整體營收與獲利預計逐季走高，下半年表現將優於上半年(實際狀況仍需視客戶拉貨時程與供應鏈狀況而定)。此外，公司持續引進自動化設備生產，對整體毛利率有顯著幫助，管理層對未來保持樂觀。

Q2：公司對於水冷(Liquid Cooling)業務的營收比重如何拆分？ 

回答：公司不對外拆分水冷業務的單一營收比重。主因是水冷專案包含 Cooling、Manifold、Quick Disconnect (QD) 等多項組件，部分專案更涵蓋機構件與風扇。公司定位為「全方位熱能與機構解決方案提供者(Total Thermal and Mechanical Solution Provider)」，內部管理以專案與客戶維度為主，不以氣冷/水冷劃分。但可確定的是，AI Server 對營收的貢獻比重持續上升。

Q3：NVIDIA GB200(或 B200)水冷產品的出貨進度與新廠貢獻時程？ 

回答：完全依照客戶給予的專案排程推進。目前新廠針對相關產品已開始進入量產階段，預計於第三季(Q3)開始產生營收貢獻。

Q4：針對 Google、Amazon 等大型 CSP 客戶的 ASIC/TPU 專案，供貨情況與滲透率為何？ 

回答：公司不評論單一客戶細節，但強調在核心 ASIC 客戶群中皆維持主導的供應商地位。水冷滲透率正顯著提高，許多客戶的第一代、第二代 ASIC 專案已開始放量生產，公司均為主要供應商，並持續提供設計、驗證到量產的一站式服務。

Q5：ASIC 與 GPU 散熱產品的發展方向為何？2027 年 ASIC 比重是否會超越 GPU？ 

回答：公司並未針對 ASIC 與 GPU 做細項比例統計，且對公司而言兩者並非二選一。無論是 ASIC 還是 GPU 平臺，對於散熱功耗與機櫃密度的需求都在大幅提升，因此兩大平臺都會持續出貨並共同受益。

Q6：雙相浸沒式水冷(Two-phase Cooling)的開發進度與市場接受度如何？ 

回答：公司擁有專業研發團隊且技術成熟，雙相水冷的散熱表現確實優於單相水冷。然而，評估目前晶片 TDP 與系統可靠度後，客戶現階段權衡下仍以「單相直接水冷(Single-phase Cold Plate)」為最適方案。散熱技術會隨需求漸進式演進，不會出現一夕之間的斷崖式技術更替。

Q7：若未來晶片功耗(TDP)達到 3000W 到 5000W 以上，散熱方案如何因應？ 

回答：公司現階段已可提供 3000W 以上的散熱解決方案，技術上並無物理天花板。未來的解法包含：強化單相水冷、優化機櫃架構、調校流量、採用裸晶封裝或金屬套件(Metal Kit)等，會依據客戶系統層級的限制提供客製化組合。

Q8：機殼與機櫃(Server Chassis/Rack)事業的展望與毛利變化？ 

回答：隨著機櫃密度提升，機殼需要承載 Manifold、風扇、水冷組件等，結構強度、氣流設計與可維修性難度大增，帶動單櫃價值量與設計門檻顯著提升。雖然不針對單一產品評論毛利率，但整體發展趨勢會越來越好，機殼/機構件將隨水冷產品一同強勁成長。

Q9：今年的資本支出(Capex)規劃與籌資計畫？ 

回答：今年的 Capital Expenditure (Capex) 預計約為新臺幣 150 億元，明年的 Capex 會比今年更多(產能擴充以越南廠區為主)。目前營運現金流與銀行額度相當充裕，足以支應現有擴產計畫，暫無其他籌資計畫。

Q10：面對市場對 CSP 客戶 Capex 投資回報的疑慮，公司對 AI 長期趨勢的看法？ 

回答：公司堅信 AI 趨勢是真實且持續發展的。整體產業在技術、資源與資本上的投入不斷增加，水冷在資料中心(Data Center)的滲透率今年確定會持續提升(預計滲透率將超過 50%)。

items.title: 永捷上半年EPS-0.1元虧損大幅收斂 下半年加速「多角化發展」策略
items.title_en: Evergreen Chemical Reports Narrower Loss in First Half, Eyes Diversification Strategy
paras: PU合成廠永捷(4714-TW)公告今(2026)年上半年自結財報，稅後淨損1,774 萬元、每股稅後淨損0.1元，整體營運表現較去(2025)年同期虧損大幅收斂。永捷表示，受惠於集團整合協同效益顯現，公司持續優化產品組合結構，嚴控成本費用，加上業外表現挹注業績表現，下半年將採取「垂直整合、多角化發展」策略，深化傳統PU與高科技電子產業之全方位應用。
永捷今年上半年合併營收達11.85 億元、年增76.15％；稅後淨損1,774 萬元，整體營運表現較去年同期虧損大幅收斂，營業毛利為1.73 億元、年增28.76％，受惠於集團整合協同效益顯現，公司持續優化產品組合結構，並嚴控成本費用。

永捷今年7月營收達1.5億元、月增5.65％、年增14.66％；累計2026年1-7 月合併營收達13.34 億元、年增66.13％，7月單月與前7月累計營收雙雙刷新歷年同期新高，成長主因在於公司積極布局高附加價值之環保型PU樹脂與水性PU材料，隨著運動鞋材、機能服飾及傳統皮革等終端市場需求回溫，客戶拉貨力道強勁，帶動產能利用率顯著提升。同時，永捷旗下「荷久暻」建案如期完工交屋並認列房產銷售收入，雙引擎齊發助也推升營收繳出亮眼成績單。
展望2026 年下半年，永捷維持審慎樂觀態度。公司將持續以「綠色環保」與「高附加價值」為核心，發揮台灣廠作為全球研發與運籌中心之優勢，並積極開展海外策略聯盟。
面對國際地緣政治與通膨壓力等全球總體經濟挑戰，永捷表示，將採取「垂直整合、多角化發展」策略，深化傳統PU 市場與高科技電子產業之全方位應用，在產銷政策上，重點布局高固成分與無溶劑濕氣反應型PUR、TPU 產品，油/水性家具革與汽車革，以及快乾型架橋劑與成衣環保水性產品。
paras_en: Evergreen Chemical (4714-TW) announced its unaudited consolidated financial report for the first half of 2026, with a net loss of NT$17.74 million and a net loss per share of NT$0.1. The company's overall performance improved significantly compared to the same period last year.

Evergreen Chemical's consolidated revenue for the first half of 2026 reached NT$1.185 billion, a year-on-year increase of 76.15%. The company's net loss was NT$17.74 million, with a significant improvement in overall performance compared to the same period last year. Gross profit was NT$173 million, a year-on-year increase of 28.76%.

Evergreen Chemical's revenue in July reached NT$150 million, a month-on-month increase of 5.65% and a year-on-year increase of 14.66%. The company's cumulative revenue for January-July 2026 reached NT$1.334 billion, a year-on-year increase of 66.13%. Both the July single-month and cumulative revenue for the first seven months broke new highs, driven by the company's active layout of high-value-added environmentally friendly PU resins and water-based PU materials.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Evergreen Chemical maintains a cautious optimism. The company will continue to focus on 'green and environmentally friendly' and 'high-value-added' products, leveraging its Taiwan-based manufacturing as a global R&D and logistics center, and actively developing overseas strategic partnerships.

In the face of global economic challenges such as international geopolitics and inflationary pressures, Evergreen Chemical will adopt a 'vertical integration and diversification' strategy, deepening its application of traditional PU markets and high-tech electronics industries. The company will focus on developing high-solid content and solvent-free wet reaction type PUR, TPU products, oil/water-based furniture leather and automotive leather, as well as fast-drying type bridging agents and environmentally friendly water-based clothing products.

paras: 屬台積電 (2330-TW) 供應鏈的設備廠迅得 (6438-TW) 今(12)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年上半年稅後純益3.11億元，年增19.07%，每股純益達3.79元，公司擬對上半年股利配息3元，並擬發行5億元無擔保可轉換公司債進行市場籌資。
迅得2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，稅後純益1.66億元，單季獲利也超越首季的 1.45 億元，每股純益2.03元。2026年1-6月營收35.68億元，毛利率26.13%，稅後純益3.11億元，每股純益3.79元。而迅得公布最新營收資訊，迅得2026 年 7 月營收以 6.38 億元改寫歷年同期新高。
迅得營運總部也在遷入的新生廠，產能已進人滿載，將推升 2026 年獲利成長幅度攀高。迅得機械在 2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創新高，法人估計迅得 2026 年第三季單月平均營收在 6 億元之上 ，有機會再創新高，第四季由於安排出貨的半導體設備出貨逐步步入高峰，預估下半年營運勝過 上半年，全年營收將再較 2025 年的 64.67 億元再增 10-15%，再創新高。
迅得擁有在半導體及 PCB 設備需求雙重成長動能，同時，迅得在 PCB 設備指向高階產品廠商的需求，也與臻鼎 - KY(4958-TW) 及景碩 (3189-TW) 有大單確立，其中臻鼎 - KY 下單 10.2 億元，而景碩也在 7 億元之上。。
迅得 2026 年上半年營收 35.68 億元，年增 11.99%，2026 下半年預估在出貨產品組合的有利因素加持下超過上半年表現 ，全年營收估成長 10-15%，而在獲利成長幅度可望以優於營收成長幅度倍數成長呈現。
同時，迅得半導體相關設備出貨上將在第四季起出現明顯成長，半導體設備營收在 2027 年也將維持此一營運旺盛態勢。
迅得在今年第一季營收爲 17.45 億元，稅後純益 1.45 億元，每股純益 1.76 元，第二季營收 18.24 億元，在出貨產品組合、匯率有利及收回逾期帳款挹注之下，迅得 2026 年第二季營收、獲利較首季增加。
在迅得產能規劃方面，迅得新建中壢新生廠的廠房高達 1.2 萬坪，公司營運總部也遷入新生廠；迅得中壢新生廠設有無塵室並主攻半導體設備生產，迅得董事長王年清指出，目前中壢新生廠產能並已經滿載，迅得正設法取得取得其他營運及倉儲空間以確保備妥下半年營運增溫的需求。
paras_en: XunDe (6438‑TW), a equipment supplier in TSMC’s (2330‑TW) supply chain, announced on the 12th its latest profit figures: H1 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$311 million, up 19.07% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$3.79. The company intends to pay a NT$3 dividend for the first half and plans to issue NT$5 billion of unsecured convertible bonds to raise capital in the market.

In Q2 2026 XunDe recorded revenue of NT$1.824 billion, a new high, with after‑tax net profit of NT$166 million. The quarterly profit also surpassed Q1’s NT$145 million, delivering EPS of NT$2.03. For the January‑June period, revenue reached NT$3.568 billion, gross margin was 26.13%, after‑tax net profit was NT$311 million and EPS was NT$3.79. The company also reported that July 2026 revenue of NT$638 million set a new historical high for the month.

July 2026 revenue was NT$638 million, up 7.61% month‑over‑month and 5.38% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑July 2026 amounted to NT$4.207 billion, an increase of 10.97% from the prior year.

XunDe’s operations headquarters has moved into the new Xinsheng plant, where capacity is already fully loaded, which is expected to lift profit growth in 2026. The machinery segment posted a record Q2 revenue of NT$1.824 billion; analysts estimate that average monthly revenue in Q3 2026 will exceed NT$600 million, potentially setting another record. In Q4, shipments of semiconductor equipment are expected to peak, and the second half is forecasted to outperform the first half. Full‑year revenue is projected to grow 10‑15% over 2025’s NT$6.467 billion, reaching a new high.

XunDe enjoys dual growth momentum from semiconductor and PCB equipment demand. In the PCB segment, targeting high‑end product makers, it has secured large orders from Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW) and Jing Shuo (3189‑TW). Zhen Ding‑KY placed an order worth NT$1.02 billion, while Jing Shuo’s order exceeds NT$700 million.

H1 2026 revenue was NT$3.568 billion, up 11.99% year‑over‑year. The company expects H2 revenue to surpass H1 performance thanks to favorable product‑mix factors, projecting full‑year revenue growth of 10‑15%. Profit growth is anticipated to outpace revenue growth by a multiple.
Semiconductor‑related equipment shipments are expected to show a clear increase starting in Q4, and semiconductor equipment revenue is expected to remain robust throughout 2027.

In Q1 2026, XunDe generated revenue of NT$1.745 billion, after‑tax net profit of NT$145 million and EPS of NT$1.76. In Q2, revenue rose to NT$1.824 billion, driven by a favorable product mix, advantageous exchange‑rate effects and the recovery of overdue receivables, resulting in higher revenue and profit compared with Q1.

Regarding capacity planning, XunDe’s newly built Zhongli Xinsheng plant spans 12,000 ping, and the company’s operations headquarters has relocated there. The plant features a cleanroom and focuses on semiconductor equipment production. Chairman Wang Nianqing noted that the Xinsheng plant’s capacity is already fully utilized, and the company is seeking additional operational and warehousing space to ensure it can meet the increased demand anticipated in the second half of the year.

items.title: 〈聯亞法說〉CW Laser產能供不應求 基板缺料問題不大
items.title_en: Lianya's Law: CW Laser production in short supply, substrate shortage not significant
paras: 聯亞 (3081-TW) 今 (12) 日下午舉行法說會，並自結公告今 ( 2026) 年第 2 季、上半年財報及說明未來布局展望，聯亞因受惠矽光產品需求強勁、出貨持續放大挹注下，第 2 季除了獲利創單新高，在矽光產品上，隨AI資料中心帶動需求，目前產能狀況已相當吃緊，產品中Datacom中CW Laser占比最大，也陸續擴大資本支出及代工因應。
聯亞第 2 季財報繳出三率三升，連續 2 季繳出佳績。隨著資料中心需求持續增加，聯亞表示，矽光需求依然非常強勁，隨著公司與下游代工廠的產能持續攀升，預期矽光產品出貨量在未來幾個季度還會持續增加。
聯亞指出，目前CW Laser產能狀況已相當吃緊，代工廠產能遠遠不足公司需求，也證實的確有些訂單委由外面代工廠代工，同時在AI資料中心持續建置下，CW Laser在光通訊後續發展上具有很大優勢，這也是目前聯亞仍持續擴大資本支出的原因，公司主要產能上還是放在CW Laser上。
此外，針對原料磷化銦(InP)全球持續缺料影響，聯亞也表示，雖受中國管制，但聯亞已與其他供應商有持續接觸，目前基板缺料問題不大。
聯亞強調，未來資料中心在AI應用上從過去scale-out，接下來將會導入光通訊，逐步延伸至EML及接收端光電二極體(PD)等，EML與CW Laser各有應用優勢，並非相互取代或互斥，不同的光通訊傳輸也互有優勢。
paras_en: Lianya (3081-TW) held a law meeting today (12) and announced its second quarter and first half of 2026 financial report, as well as its future layout outlook. Lianya benefited from the strong demand for silicon light products, with continuous shipments increasing, and its second quarter profit reached a new high. In addition, due to the strong demand for silicon light products driven by AI data centers, the current production capacity is already quite tight. The company has also expanded its capital expenditures and outsourcing to cope with the situation.

Lianya's second quarter financial report achieved a three-rate three-rise, with two consecutive quarters of good performance. As the demand for data centers continues to increase, Lianya stated that the demand for silicon light products remains extremely strong, and with the company's production capacity and downstream outsourcing factories continuing to rise, it is expected that silicon light product shipments will continue to increase in the next few quarters.

Lianya pointed out that the current CW Laser production capacity is already quite tight, and the outsourcing factory's production capacity is far from meeting the company's demand. It has been confirmed that some orders have been outsourced to external factories. Meanwhile, with the continuous construction of AI data centers, CW Laser has a significant advantage in the development of optical communication, which is also the reason why Lianya is still expanding its capital expenditures. The company's main production capacity is still focused on CW Laser.

In addition, Lianya also stated that, despite the global shortage of indium phosphide (InP) substrate, which is subject to Chinese regulations, Lianya has been in continuous contact with other suppliers, and the substrate shortage is not significant.

Lianya emphasized that in the future, data centers will transition from scale-out to optical communication, and will gradually extend to EML and receive end optical photodiodes (PD). EML and CW Laser have different application advantages and are not mutually exclusive or mutually exclusive. Different optical communication transmission also has its own advantages.

items.title: 微軟Win 11授權費傳已最高調漲10% OEM廠首當其衝
items.title_en: Microsoft Windows 11 License Fees Said to Have Jumped Up to 10%—OEMs Hit First
paras: 全球消費性電子產業今年深陷漲價壓力，記憶體、邏輯晶片等半導體供應短缺，不僅推升硬體成本，漲價潮如今更延燒至軟體。業界消息指出，微軟(MSFT-US) 已將 Windows 11 授權費調高最多 10%，且此次漲價並非針對 DIY 用戶，而是直接影響銷售整機的 OEM 廠商，進一步加重成本負擔。
據個人電腦OEM業者透露，微軟雖然每年皆會慣例性地微調授權費，但今年的漲幅明顯擴大，平均達到7%至10%。此外，微軟的授權費調漲並非一成不變，而是根據處理器效能採取階梯式計價，CPU越高端，費用就越高。
儘管從整體結構來看，微軟的授權費對整機價格的影響，遠不及記憶體和固態硬碟（SSD）價格的飆漲幅度，但它仍然是導致終端電腦購買成本比以往更高的一個重要因素。
面對「軟硬體齊漲」的雙重壓力，PC品牌廠今年營運挑戰不斷。消息稱，華碩和宏碁等大廠將在今年稍後將價格再上調約5%，且與2025年第四季相比，華碩產品的平均漲幅已達到30%。
有PC品牌主管坦言，雖然產品售價已陸續反映本次微軟調漲的授權費，但由於今年其他關鍵零組件漲幅實在過大，消費者與企業對於單一成本項目的變動已較難產生明顯感受。
雪上加霜的是，近階段個人電腦出貨量也出現了明顯下滑。根據Counterpoint Research報告顯示，2026年第二季全球個人電腦市場出貨量年減約4%至4.9%，這是自2025年第一季度以來全球PC市場首次出現下滑。
聯想集團(00992-HK) 、惠普(HPQ-US) 、戴爾(DELL-US) 等主要生產商均面臨銷售量下滑的困境，蘋果則成為少數出貨量逆勢增加10%以上的廠商。
雖然持續攀升的價格理論上能提升企業的利潤，但Counterpoint指出，Windows系統遷移周期和AI PC普及雖然仍在支撐部分商業換機需求，持續攀升的記憶體價格和零組件成本卻正在兩頭擠壓OEM廠商。
業界擔憂，如果這種價格上漲趨勢持續失控，消費者未來可能不再傾向於購買新電腦，這對整體產業來說無疑是個巨大的隱憂。
paras_en: The global consumer electronics industry is under intense price‑increase pressure this year, with shortages of memory, logic chips and other semiconductors driving up hardware costs, and the inflation wave now spreading to software. Industry sources say Microsoft (MSFT‑US) has raised Windows 11 licensing fees by as much as 10%, and the hike is not aimed at DIY users but directly impacts OEMs that sell complete systems, further burdening their cost base.

According to a PC OEM, Microsoft typically makes small annual adjustments to its licensing fees, but this year’s increase is markedly larger, averaging between 7% and 10%. Moreover, the fee hike is tiered by processor performance—the higher‑end the CPU, the higher the charge.

Although, in the overall cost structure, Microsoft’s licensing fees affect the final price of a system far less than the soaring prices of memory and solid‑state drives (SSDs), they remain a significant factor that makes end‑user computer purchase costs higher than before.

Facing a “software‑and‑hardware‑both‑rising” double pressure, PC brands are confronting continual operational challenges this year. Sources say major makers such as Asus and Acer will raise their prices by roughly another 5% later this year, and compared with Q4 2025, the average price increase for Asus products has already reached 30%.

A PC brand executive admitted that although product prices have begun to reflect Microsoft’s licensing fee increase, the magnitude of price hikes in other key components this year is so large that consumers and enterprises find it hard to notice the impact of any single cost item.

Adding to the strain, recent PC shipment volumes have shown a clear decline. Counterpoint Research reports that global PC shipments in Q2 2026 fell year‑over‑year by about 4% to 4.9%, marking the first decline in the global PC market since Q1 2025.

Major manufacturers such as Lenovo Group (00992‑HK), HP (HPQ‑US) and Dell (DELL‑US) are all facing falling sales, while Apple is one of the few companies whose shipments have risen by more than 10% against the trend.

Although rising prices theoretically can boost corporate margins, Counterpoint notes that the Windows migration cycle and the spread of AI PCs still support some business‑upgrade demand, but the continuously climbing memory prices and component costs are squeezing OEMs from both ends.

The industry worries that if this price‑increase trend continues unchecked, consumers may become reluctant to buy new computers in the future, which would pose a huge hidden risk to the entire sector.

items.title: Falcon 9需求續強！Applied Aerospace太空業務營收大增58.5%，訂單估延續至2030年
items.title_en: Falcon 9 Demand Continues Strong! Applied Aerospace Space Business Revenue Grows 58.5%, Orders Expected to Continue to 2030
paras: 2026年08月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ SpaceX供應商Applied Aerospace & Defense(AADX-US)在2026年第2季法說會透露，Falcon 9相關產品需求持續強勁，帶動太空與發射系統(Space and Launch Systems)業務快速成長，管理層並預期Falcon 9相關訂單至少可延續至2030年。
Applied Aerospace主要為太空與國防客戶設計及製造關鍵航太結構與次系統。在SpaceX供應鏈中，公司供應Falcon 9相關產品，包括可重複使用火箭的著陸硬體，以及用於保護火箭鼻端與酬載的複合材料結構件。公司整體太空產品則涵蓋發射與酬載部署系統、衛星與酬載組件、天線、太陽能陣列，以及可重複使用著陸系統等。
第2季太空與發射系統營收達3,880萬美元，年增58.5%，主要受發射載具及衛星生產計畫出貨增加帶動。公司特別指出，SpaceX Falcon 9相關產品需求強勁，是推升該部門成長的重要動能。
管理層表示，SpaceX是公司非常重要的客戶，目前Falcon 9訂單仍持續流入。依照SpaceX目前提供的需求規劃，公司預期相關業務至少可延續至2030年，並認為Falcon 9的實際產品生命週期可能更長。
除了Falcon 9，Applied Aerospace也已參與多項Starship相關工作。管理層指出，雖然Starship大量採用金屬結構，但公司的複合材料技術仍有機會應用於酬載及其他系統，目前已有部分相關項目進行中。
Applied Aerospace第2季整體營收達1.67億美元，年增47.4%，季底積壓訂單突破11億美元、創歷史新高。隨Falcon 9訂單延續及Starship合作項目增加，SpaceX後續發射與火箭產能擴張將成為公司太空業務的重要需求來源。

paras_en: August 12, 2026 (Opt Analytics/Industry Data Center Report) - SpaceX supplier Applied Aerospace & Defense (AADX-US) revealed at its 2Q 2026 earnings call that demand for Falcon 9-related products continues strong, driving rapid growth in space and launch systems business, with management expecting Falcon 9-related orders to continue at least until 2030.

Applied Aerospace primarily designs and manufactures critical aerospace structures and sub-systems for space and defense customers. In the SpaceX supply chain, the company supplies Falcon 9-related products, including reusable rocket landing hardware and composite material structural components used to protect the rocket nose and payload. The company's overall space products cover launch and payload deployment systems, satellite and payload components, antennas, solar arrays, and reusable landing systems.

The company's 2Q space and launch systems revenue reached $38.8 million, up 58.5% year-over-year, mainly driven by increased shipments of launch vehicles and satellite production plans. The company specifically noted that strong demand for SpaceX Falcon 9-related products is a key driver of growth in this segment.

Management stated that SpaceX is a very important customer, and Falcon 9 orders continue to flow in. Based on SpaceX's current demand planning, the company expects related business to continue at least until 2030 and believes that the actual product lifecycle of Falcon 9 may be longer.

In addition to Falcon 9, Applied Aerospace has also participated in multiple Starship-related projects. Management noted that while Starship heavily uses metal structures, the company's composite material technology still has opportunities for application in payloads and other systems, with some related projects currently underway.

Applied Aerospace's 2Q overall revenue reached $167 million, up 47.4% year-over-year, with backlog orders exceeding $1.1 billion, a new historical high. With Falcon 9 orders continuing and Starship cooperation projects increasing, SpaceX's subsequent launches and rocket production expansion will become an important source of demand for the company's space business.

items.title: 強行升息只會把事情搞砸！摩根大通策略師警告Fed別操之過急
items.title_en: JPMorgan Strategist Warns Fed Against Overstepping on Rate Hikes
paras: 摩根大通資產管理(JPMorgan Asset Management)全球首席策略師David Kelly表示，聯準會(Fed)應維持利率不變，而且最終也很可能選擇按兵不動，因為美國通膨正沿著明確的降溫軌道前進，持續性薪資—物價螺旋成形的風險也逐漸下降。
美國7月核心通膨表現溫和，數據公布後美債延續漲勢。Kelly接受《彭博》電視訪問時直言，Fed「絕對應該」維持利率不變，試圖透過升息加快通膨回落，不僅無法帶來好處，反而可能破壞經濟與金融市場。
Kelly認為，三股力量正共同推動通膨降溫。首先，關稅成本的年增影響將逐步減弱；其次，市場對美伊戰爭結束抱持樂觀期待，有望帶動油價回落；最後，薪資成長持續落後於通膨，使物價壓力缺乏自我強化所需的燃料，Fed也就沒有非升息不可的理由。
他將當前情況形容為美國正面臨「鐵氟龍式通膨」(Teflon inflation)，意指通膨壓力不會牢牢黏住經濟。Kelly表示，通膨就像傷勢一樣，只能緩慢痊癒，若強行加快過程，反而可能把事情弄得更糟；只要薪資沒有跟著物價加速上漲，就難以形成薪資—物價螺旋。
Kelly也批評Fed近期的溝通策略，認為主席華許(Kevin Warsh)8月底在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)全球央行年會的演說將是關鍵時刻。華許必須稍微收回先前過於強硬的論調，承認Fed在抑制通膨方面已取得一定進展。他並認為，Fed暗示未來將減少與市場溝通，是走在錯誤的道路上。
至於升息是否能重建Fed抗通膨公信力，進而壓低長天期美債殖利率，Kelly坦言這是一個難以判斷的選擇。但他警告，相較升息，量化緊縮可能是更危險的政策工具，因為對長期利率的推升作用更強；若同時升息與縮減資產負債表，恐增加市場失序的風險。
Kelly指出，目前金融市場槓桿程度相當高，即使只是小幅升息，也可能觸發各類資產重新定價。短期利率升高將促使投資人轉向較安全的資產，抽走部分市場上漲動能，Fed沒有必要為了加速通膨降溫而承擔這項風險。
paras_en: JPMorgan Asset Management's global chief strategist David Kelly says the Federal Reserve should keep interest rates unchanged and is likely to do so as US inflation is moving along a clear downward trajectory, with the risk of a persistent wage-price spiral diminishing.

US core inflation showed a mild performance in July, and after the data was released, US Treasury yields continued to rise. Kelly told Bloomberg TV that the Fed "absolutely should" keep interest rates unchanged, attempting to accelerate inflation decline through rate hikes, which would not only fail to bring benefits but could also damage the economy and financial markets.

Kelly believes that three forces are driving down inflation. Firstly, the year-over-year impact of tariff costs will gradually weaken; secondly, the market's optimistic expectations for the end of the US-Iran war may lead to a decline in oil prices; and thirdly, wage growth continues to lag behind inflation, making it difficult for prices to sustain themselves, leaving the Fed without a reason to raise interest rates.

He describes the current situation as the US facing "Teflon inflation," meaning that inflationary pressure will not stick to the economy. Kelly says that inflation is like an injury, which can only heal slowly, and that forcing a faster process could make things worse; as long as wages do not accelerate with prices, it is difficult to form a wage-price spiral.

Kelly also criticizes the Fed's recent communication strategy, saying that Chairman Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Conference at the end of August will be a critical moment. Warsh must slightly retract his previous overly hawkish tone and acknowledge that the Fed has made some progress in suppressing inflation. He also believes that the Fed's hint that it will reduce market communication is on the wrong track.

As for whether rate hikes can rebuild the Fed's credibility in fighting inflation and thereby lower long-term US Treasury yields, Kelly says it is a difficult choice to make. However, he warns that quantitative tightening may be a more dangerous policy tool, as it has a stronger impact on long-term interest rates; if the Fed raises interest rates and reduces its balance sheet at the same time, it may increase the risk of market disorder.

Kelly notes that the financial market's leverage is currently high, and even a small rate hike could trigger a re-pricing of various assets. Higher short-term interest rates would encourage investors to move to safer assets, draining some of the market's upward momentum, and the Fed does not need to take on this risk to accelerate the decline of inflation.

paras_en: August 12, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Demand for AI infrastructure remains robust, and optimistic outlooks from CoreWeave (CRWV-US) and Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) drove their Wednesday shares up more than 20% and 16% respectively. Nebius採用輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)GPU提供AI雲端運算服務，第2季簽下4筆大型合約，每筆平均價值超過10億美元。整體合約總值較前一季增加近3倍，新客戶合約價值則增加超過8倍。
為擴充GPU與資料中心產能，Nebius第2季資本支出約57億美元，高於Visible Alpha分析師預估的47億美元，顯示公司持續大舉投入AI算力基礎建設。
面對市場新增AI算力供給，Nebius管理層表示，目前競爭環境並未改變公司的市場狀況，並指出若維持現行合約條件，公司甚至有能力售出所有規劃中的2027年產能。
Nebius也將2026年底已簽約電力容量目標由原先超過4 GW上調至5 GW，並預計自2027年起每年新增超過1 GW運算容量。第2季簽署的AI雲端合約，每MW年合約價值超過2,000萬美元，預計自第4季末開始投入服務。
公司預計2026年可收到超過90億美元客戶預付款，目前客戶承諾金額則超過400億美元。
Nebius財報發布前一天，競爭對手CoreWeave(CRWV-US)也調高全年財測。兩家公司最新營運表現顯示，AI運算容量需求仍高於供給，帶動AI基礎建設相關個股同步走強。

paras_en: August 12, 2026 (Optimal Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) - The demand for AI infrastructure continues to exceed supply, with cloud computing company Nebius Group (NBIS-US) reporting second-quarter revenue that exceeds market expectations, with AI cloud business revenue growing nearly sixfold, driving a 17% surge in stock price on Wednesday morning.

Nebius' second-quarter revenue reached $582.3 million, exceeding the London Stock Exchange Group's (LSEG) market estimate of $572.75 million, primarily driven by the strong growth of AI cloud business. CEO Arkady Volozh stated that the company is converting rapidly increasing AI demand into signed and profitable growth.

Nebius uses NVIDIA (NVDA-US) GPUs to provide AI cloud computing services, signing four large contracts in the second quarter, each with an average value exceeding $1 billion. The total contract value increased nearly threefold compared to the previous quarter, with new customer contract values increasing over eightfold.

To expand GPU and data center capacity, Nebius invested approximately $5.7 billion in capital expenditures in the second quarter, exceeding Visible Alpha analyst estimates of $4.7 billion, indicating that the company continues to heavily invest in AI infrastructure.

In the face of market additions to AI infrastructure supply, Nebius' management stated that the current competitive environment has not changed the company's market situation, and that if the current contract conditions are maintained, the company can even sell all the planned 2027 capacity.

Nebius also raised its 2026 year-end contracted power capacity target from over 4 GW to 5 GW and expects to add over 1 GW of computing capacity annually from 2027 onwards. The second-quarter signed AI cloud contracts have a contract value of over $20 million per MW per year, expected to be deployed from the fourth quarter onwards.
The company expects to receive over $9 billion in customer prepayments in 2026, with current customer commitments exceeding $40 billion.

Before Nebius' earnings report, its competitor CoreWeave (CRWV-US) also raised its full-year earnings forecast. The latest operating performance of the two companies shows that AI computing capacity demand remains higher than supply, driving AI infrastructure-related stocks to rise in unison.

items.title: Fed下月可以先不升息？華爾街解讀7月CPI三大訊號
paras: 美國7月消費者物價指數(CPI)符合預期，未出現市場擔心的意外升溫，稍微緩解聯準會(Fed)9月升息壓力。華爾街分析師從中讀出三大訊號：核心通膨持續降溫、勞動市場轉弱支持Fed繼續觀望，但部分基礎物價壓力仍高，加上中東局勢與油價前景充滿變數。因此，這份報告雖有助於強化9月按兵不動的理由，卻仍不足以宣告通膨警報解除。
美國7月CPI月增0.1%、年增3.4%，核心CPI月增0.2%、年增2.5%，均符合市場預期。美股開高，美國2年期與10年期公債殖利率分別下跌4.2個及3.2個基點，美元指數小跌0.1%。利率期貨顯示，市場預估Fed在9月15日至16日維持利率於3.50%至3.75%的機率約55%，與數據公布前相差不大。

數據不差但也不夠好 9月升息之爭尚未落幕

高盛資產管理(Goldman Sachs Asset Management)多元固定收益投資主管Lindsay Rosner形容，7月CPI只是Fed 9月會議前的「第一關」，由於屆時還有另一輪通膨數據出爐，目前各種可能性仍然存在。不過，核心通膨維持受控，延續前一個月基礎物價壓力趨緩的正面跡象，確實進一步強化9月按兵不動的理由。
Natixis美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge表示，通膨正緩慢但穩定地沿著降溫路徑前進，這已是核心CPI連續第三個月傳出令人鼓舞的結果，近三個月年化增幅更連續四個月下降，顯示廣泛性通膨壓力持續減弱。在上周五就業報告表現慘淡後，市場對「正面通膨數據」的認定門檻已經放寬，而7月CPI顯然符合條件。
Dakota Wealth資深投資組合經理Robert Pavlik指出，市場之所以做出小幅正面反應，不是因為數據特別亮眼，而是投資人原先擔心通膨可能比預期更糟。如今結果完全符合預估，加上疲弱的非農就業報告，降低Fed因能源價格推升通膨而被迫升息的疑慮。
CFRA Research首席投資策略師Sam Stovall認為，通膨沒有意外上升，加上近期經濟成長及就業表現轉弱，Fed 9月升息的可能性很低，今年甚至很可能完全不升息。雖然新任Fed主席首次政策行動過去往往偏向升息，Fed也面臨維護抗通膨公信力的壓力，但目前經濟恐難承受積極緊縮；即使利率小幅上調，也不太可能是新一輪激進升息循環的起點。

鷹派仍不死心 價格穩定公信力成升息理由

並非所有分析師都認為Fed已無須升息。施羅德(Schroders)資深經濟學家George Brown指出，7月CPI並未真正解決Fed下一步行動的爭論。勞動市場看似轉弱，但部分基礎通膨指標仍亮起紅燈，決策官員在9月會議前面對的是相互矛盾的訊號。
Brown表示，近期長天期美債遭到拋售，使Fed更須避免市場懷疑其維護價格穩定的決心。鷹派言論能發揮的作用有限，實際行動往往比口頭承諾更具說服力，因此他仍認為利率最終方向偏高，只是首次升息的時間尚不明確。
Allspring Global Investments固定收益首席投資策略師George Bory則認為，美國通膨可能已越過高峰，7月數據確實減輕Fed的部分壓力，但現在宣告一切安全仍言之過早，因為若干基礎通膨指標依舊偏高。他預期Fed今年不會升息，但這項判斷很大程度取決於油價與中東情勢。
Capital.com資深市場分析師Daniela Hathorn也表示，這是一份對Fed有幫助的報告，卻不是解除警報的訊號。通膨在先前能源衝擊後朝正確方向前進，近期就業市場疲弱，也讓官員更缺乏9月再次升息的理由；然而，整體CPI年增率仍達3.4%，明顯高於Fed的2%目標，能源價格也較去年同期高出近15%，Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)不太可能就此宣告勝利。

油價仍是最大變數 消費者疲態反而壓低漲價空間

Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen形容，通膨尚未亮起「紅色警報」，雖然整體表現仍稱不上理想，但方向正在改善。部分領域依然存在極端價格壓力，例如電腦軟體與配件價格年增21.2%；相較之下，住宅與保險通膨正逐步回落，目前也沒有明確證據顯示，劇烈波動的能源價格已擴散至其他消費項目。
Jacobsen指出，長期承受高物價的消費者已顯疲憊，購買力與承受漲價的能力下降，反而限制生產商把成本轉嫁給消費者的空間。這可能有助於抑制通膨的廣泛擴散，但也反映家庭生活成本壓力仍未解除。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，在疲弱就業數據與市場預期CPI偏軟的背景下，他原本預期美元會有更明顯跌勢，但匯市反應相當有限。CPI公布後美元僅略為走弱，顯示市場只是非常小幅地下調9月升息機率。
分析師的共同結論是，7月CPI沒有把Fed推向升息，卻也沒有徹底排除升息。通膨降溫與就業疲弱提高9月按兵不動的合理性，但油價走勢、8月就業與通膨數據，以及Fed維護政策公信力的考量，仍可能改變最終結果。

paras: 美國7月通膨數據符合預期，緩解市場對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的擔憂，美股主要指數周三(12日)開高。標普500指數上漲0.5%，徘徊在歷史高點附近；那斯達克綜合指數上漲0.9%，道瓊工業指數上漲151點或0.3%。
AI概念股CoreWeave與美超微領漲科技股，那斯達克100指數一度上漲約1%。債市同步走強，美國2年期公債殖利率下跌4個基點至4.17%，貨幣市場則下調Fed在9月升息的押注。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲逾 160 點或近 0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近 60 點或 近 0.2%，標普 500 指數漲 0.02%，費城半導體指數漲 1.0%。台積電 ADR 漲近 0.4%。
美國7月消費者物價指數(CPI)符合市場預期，緩解投資人對Fed近期升息的擔憂，帶動美股期指與美債價格周三同步上漲。科技股反彈進一步提振市場情緒，那斯達克100指數期貨漲幅達1%，標普500指數可望延續8月以來的漲勢。
債市方面，對Fed政策較敏感的美國2年期公債殖利率下跌3個基點至4.18%，貨幣市場也降低對Fed在9月升息的押注。在地緣政治風險與油價仍處高檔之際，通膨數據未進一步惡化，令華爾街交易員鬆一口氣。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)公布，7月整體CPI月增0.1%、年增3.4%；剔除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI月增0.2%、年增2.5%，均符合市場預期。其中，核心CPI年增幅追平2021年3月以來最低水準，顯示基礎通膨壓力持續趨緩。
在上周五公布的7月就業報告表現疲弱後，物價漲勢降溫可能進一步減輕Fed對通膨的焦慮。Fed於7月29日決議維持利率不變，但有三名官員投下反對票並主張升息，凸顯決策內部分歧。
高盛資產管理(Goldman Sachs Asset Management)的Lindsay Rosner表示，核心通膨維持受控，延續6月數據顯示的基礎通膨降溫跡象，進一步強化Fed在9月按兵不動的理由。
由於Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)試圖減少央行對政策意圖的事前暗示，打破近年在正式決策前引導市場預期的慣例，經濟數據對市場的重要性也隨之提高。Fed上月維持利率不變後，長天期美債殖利率一度升至近20年高點。
Regan Capital的Skyler Weinand指出，7月CPI符合預期固然是好消息，但通膨數據正愈來愈緊密地跟隨油價變化，而Fed無法控制荷姆茲海峽局勢，這意味著通膨回落至2%目標的道路依然漫長且充滿不確定性。
Weinand表示，通膨雖處於高檔但大致穩定，Fed仍將依據數據決定下一步行動。距離9月會議前還有數項重要經濟數據待公布，升息與否尚未完全定案。
其他市場方面，油價震盪，交易員持續評估各方能否達成協議，恢復荷姆茲海峽的能源運輸。

paras_en: US stocks rose on Wednesday as July inflation data met expectations, easing concerns about a potential interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve in September. The S&P 500 index rose 0.5%, hovering near its historic high, while the Nasdaq Composite index rose 0.9% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 151 points or 0.3%.

AI concept stocks, including CoreWeave and Supermicro, led the gains in technology stocks, with the Nasdaq 100 index rising about 1% at one point. The bond market also strengthened, with the yield on the 2-year US Treasury note falling 4 basis points to 4.17%, and the money market reducing its bets on a rate hike by the Fed in September.

As of the close of trading, the Dow Jones Industrial Average had risen by over 160 points or nearly 0.3%, the Nasdaq Composite index had fallen by nearly 60 points or nearly 0.2%, the S&P 500 index had risen by 0.02%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index had risen by 1.0%. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) ADRs rose by nearly 0.4%.

The US consumer price index (CPI) for July met market expectations, easing concerns about a potential rate hike by the Fed, and boosting US stock futures and bond prices on Wednesday. The rebound in technology stocks further lifted market sentiment, with the Nasdaq 100 index futures rising by 1%, and the S&P 500 index expected to continue its upward trend since August.

In the bond market, the yield on the 2-year US Treasury note, which is more sensitive to Fed policy, fell by 3 basis points to 4.18%, and the money market reduced its bets on a rate hike by the Fed in September. With geopolitical risks and oil prices still high, the fact that inflation data did not worsen further eased concerns on Wall Street.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported that the overall CPI rose 0.1% in July from the previous month and 3.4% from a year ago, while the core CPI, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 0.2% in July from the previous month and 2.5% from a year ago, both meeting market expectations.

The core CPI's annual growth rate matched its lowest level since March 2021, indicating that underlying inflationary pressures continued to ease. After a weak jobs report was released last Friday, the easing of price pressures may further alleviate the Fed's concerns about inflation.

The Fed decided to keep interest rates unchanged on July 29, but three officials voted against the decision and advocated for a rate hike, highlighting the division within the Fed's decision-making process.

Lindsay Rosner of Goldman Sachs Asset Management said that the core inflation rate remained under control, continuing the trend of easing underlying inflation seen in June's data, and further strengthened the case for the Fed to keep interest rates unchanged in September.

Since Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh has tried to reduce the central bank's forward guidance on policy intentions, breaking the tradition of guiding market expectations before formal decisions, the importance of economic data to the market has increased. After the Fed kept interest rates unchanged last month, long-term US Treasury yields rose to near 20-year highs.

Skyler Weinand of Regan Capital pointed out that while the July CPI meeting expectations was good news, inflation data is becoming increasingly closely tied to oil price changes, and the Fed cannot control the situation in the Hormuz Strait, which means that the road to reducing inflation to the 2% target is still long and uncertain.

Weinand said that although inflation is high but stable, the Fed will still make decisions based on data. With several important economic data releases before the September meeting, the possibility of a rate hike is not entirely ruled out.
In other markets, oil prices fluctuated as traders continued to assess the possibility of an agreement to restore energy transportation through the Hormuz Strait.

As of 9 pm Taipei time on Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average had risen by 63.60 points or 0.12% to 53,855.45, the Nasdaq Composite index had risen by 156.57 points or 0.59% to 26,602.02, and the S&P 500 index had risen by 24.56 points or 0.32% to 7,752.76.

Supermicro (SMCI-US) stock price rose by 16.84% to $36.92 in early trading. The company not only reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings but also released an optimistic forecast for the first quarter.

CoreWeave (CRWV-US) stock price rose by 22.41% to $110.56 in early trading. The company's adjusted operating profit margin for the second quarter reached 5%, exceeding the 2.7% expected by FactSet analysts, and its revenue rose by 112% year-over-year to $2.58 billion, also beating expectations.
